item.title: OnAir 3.54
item.description:
What's New in OnAir 3.54

  • Meeting recording with automatic transcription (Whisper) and AI summary (Claude API).
  • New Meeting Notes screen to view recorded summaries and transcriptions.
  • Configurable summary language (French/English) in Settings.
  • Instant confirmation notifications (removed 3-second delay).
  • Fixed critical memory leak in camera monitor (autoreleasepool).
  • Fixed false meeting detections from Teams background mic polling.
  • Fixed orphaned recording processes surviving app restart.
  • Fixed menu bar showing wrong monitoring status at launch.
  • Fixed tooltip duration freezing during meetings.
  • Fixed recording not stopping when meeting ends.
  • Device forced OFF at startup and quit to prevent stale state.
  • Added Audio Input entitlement for microphone recording.
